title: Normalized finite-stage compact-support coefficient action
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type morphism between finite-type $K_0$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible in $K_0$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a compactification $c$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Use the literal rational stages and completed scalar transitions of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] and the pair categories of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Fix the already normalized coherent strict-tower/derived-limit realization of [lem-weil-compact-support-representative-independence]; write $F_E$ for its integral functor and $G_E$ for its raw Hom scalar extension. Thus the objects are the recorded compact-support values, and the image of every pure tensor is $a\otimes v\mapsto a\otimes F_E(v)$.

For each positive quotient index $n+1$, the reduction comparison $r_{E,n}$ is the tensor/restriction adjunct of the very projection chosen in the definition of the integral compact-support value, transported by the fixed value equality for $F_E$. This comparison is an isomorphism. For a finite coefficient embedding $\iota:E\hookrightarrow L$, define the mixed tensor unit by $s\otimes x\mapsto\iota_n(s)\otimes(1\otimes x)$ on sheafified tensors in the reduction tower of [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Its natural transformation is uniquely determined by this formula. Derive it through the universal tensor counits (the entire homotopy-category square, not only its values on cohomology), and compose with the prescribed diagonal Roos ordinary-to-completed scalar map of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension]. Denote the result by $\eta_{W,n}$.

A normalized compact-support coefficient action is a morphism of the recorded stage systems whose finite functors are exactly $G_E$, whose literal output pairs are $(E,G_EK)$, and whose scalar comparisons are the raw localizations of integral natural isomorphisms $b_{L/E}:T^Y_{L/E}F_E\cong F_LT^X_{L/E}$. At each $K,n$, the reduction of $b_{L/E,K}$ followed by $r_{L,n}$ is the unique tensor-linear lift of compact support of $\eta_{X,n,K}$ followed by the specified open/proper scalar-restriction comparison. The source tensor unit is $r_{E,n}^{-1}$ followed by $\eta_{Y,n,F_EK}$ and is universal for derived tensor extension along $\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^{n+1})\to\mathcal O_L/(\varpi_L^{n+1})$. Stage-system compatibility retains the scalar associator equation. For such an action define its output value to be the existing literal pair, its comparison for $\alpha:A\cong P$, $\alpha':B\cong P$ to be the image of $\alpha'^{-1}\alpha$, transported by the value equalities, and its representative at $M$ to be the literal quotient class $[M,\beta_{M/B}^{-1}G_M(u)\beta_{M/A}]$. No existence or independence assertion is included in the definition; these are asserted by the parent lemma. The fixed finite functors and their reduction comparisons are the constructions of [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action]; the mixed completed units are [def-weil-mixed-reduction-unit].
